title: Asymmetric Local Refinement Around Round 2 Configuration
scientific_hypothesis: The Round 2 thickness configuration represents a near-optimal basin; restricting search to ±3 nm for high-index layers and ±1.5 nm for low-index layers will stabilize phase relationships while allowing fine spectral tuning to improve best_target_score beyond 0.8706.
design_principle: Local gradient-based optimization with asymmetric perturbation bounds preserves the verified Round 2 phase reference while enabling micro-adjustments to dual-band spectral performance.
proposed_topology: Air | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | Fused Silica substrate (20 finite layers total, 10 HfO2 + 10 SiO2)
design_variables: layer thicknesses with asymmetric bounds relative to Round 2 best candidate
soft_objectives: maximize mean transmittance in 1000-1700 nm band
maximize mean reflectance in 300-450 nm band
manufacturing_considerations: Total layer count fixed at 20 (within 30-layer constraint)
Thickness tolerances asymmetric: high-index layers ±3 nm, low-index layers ±1.5 nm
theory_basis: Transfer matrix method for planar multilayer interference
Quarter-wave stack building blocks with modified outer layers
Gradient-based thickness optimization with bounded variables
expected_advantages: Stabilizes low-index layer phase reference at ~57 nm baseline
Allows high-index layers to fine-tune reflection band edge positions
Reduces risk of escaping Round 2 optimal basin
known_risks: Overly tight bounds may prevent escape from local minimum if Round 2 is not global optimum
Asymmetric bounds may bias optimization toward high-index layer adjustments
execution_request_english: Optimize a 20-layer alternating HfO2/SiO2 multilayer stack on fused silica substrate with air incidence. Initialize thicknesses from Round 2 best candidate: [108.66, 56.51, 115.65, 58.86, 122.67, 61.23, 130.04, 61.40, 145.56, 62.94, 152.06, 66.95, 130.76, 114.91, 115.44, 130.11, 120.17, 114.78, 52.69, 53.38] nm. Apply asymmetric optimization bounds: high-index layers (indices 0,2,4,6,8,10,12,14,16) ±3 nm from initialization; low-index layers (indices 1,3,5,7,9,11,13,15,17,18,19) ±1.5 nm from initialization. Use gradient_thickness optimizer with dual-band soft objectives: maximize mean transmittance in 1000-1700 nm, maximize mean reflectance in 300-450 nm. Evaluate at normal incidence, unpolarized light. Canonical user controls: wavelength intervals 300-450 nm, 1000-1700 nm. soft objectives: high transmission in 1000-1700 nm; high reflection in 300-450 nm. behaviors to suppress or avoid: reflection in 1000-1700 nm; transmission in 300-450 nm. manufacturing constraints: Maximum total layer count of 30.
revision_reason: Direct implementation of feedback directive: asymmetric perturbation bounds to stabilize Round 2 configuration while enabling local refinement. Round 3 regressed due to edge-layer-only constraints; this route applies bounds uniformly across all layers.
